caption: The drawing depicts an open, oval-shaped container with its lid raised, revealing the inside and outside surfaces decorated with colorful imagery. The primary color is a bright sky blue, forming the background. On the main body of the container, there is a large windmill labeled "WIND MILL of RAIL ROAD" in brown letters. To the left and right of the windmill, there are two houses with brown roofs and beige walls. Several green trees with brown trunks and branches are scattered throughout the scene. In the foreground, a brown horse pulls three connected carts with red wheels; each cart is loaded with pale tan objects, with one cart containing logs and another a covered load. The lid of the container displays a hilly landscape with winding roads, a castle-like structure with towers, additional brown-roofed buildings, and a cluster of dark green and brown trees. The inside surface is a plain, light tan. The colors used are primarily blue, brown, beige, green, and touches of red. The drawing contains lines and shading indicating texture on the windmill, houses, and trees, and the composition is arranged to fill the surfaces of the container with landscape and transportation motifs.
title: Hat Box
